# analytics

4 curated tools, plus 62 generated tools (Google Discovery parameter names; see `analytics_discover`).

## `analytics_account_summaries`

Class: read

List every Google Analytics (GA4) account and property this Google account can access, with their numeric property IDs. The starting point for any Analytics question ("what properties do I have?").

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `pageSize` | number | optional | Summaries per page (default 50, max 200) |
| `pageToken` | string | optional | Token from a previous page |

## `analytics_get_metadata`

Class: read

List every valid dimension and metric API name for a GA4 property, including its custom definitions. Call this before analytics_run_report when unsure which names exist. Property "0" returns the standard set without property access.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `property` | string | required | GA4 property: numeric ID like "213025502" or "properties/213025502" — NOT a "G-..." measurement ID and not "UA-...". Find yours with analytics_account_summaries. |

## `analytics_run_realtime_report`

Class: read

Run a GA4 realtime report: who is on the site right now (last 30 minutes). Realtime supports a restricted set of names, e.g. metrics activeUsers, screenPageViews, eventCount, keyEvents; dimensions country, city, deviceCategory, unifiedScreenName, eventName.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `property` | string | required | GA4 property: numeric ID like "213025502" or "properties/213025502" — NOT a "G-..." measurement ID and not "UA-...". Find yours with analytics_account_summaries. |
| `metrics` | array | required | Realtime metric API names, e.g. ["activeUsers"] |
| `dimensions` | array | optional | Realtime dimension API names, e.g. ["country"] or ["unifiedScreenName"] |
| `dimensionFilter` | object | optional | FilterExpression on dimensions — same shape as analytics_run_report |
| `metricFilter` | object | optional | FilterExpression on metric values — same shape as analytics_run_report |
| `minuteRanges` | array | optional | Up to 2 ranges of minutes-ago, e.g. [{"startMinutesAgo":29,"endMinutesAgo":0}] (default: last 30 minutes) |
| `limit` | number | optional | Max rows to return |
| `returnPropertyQuota` | boolean | optional | Include this property's remaining realtime quota tokens |

## `analytics_run_report`

Class: read

Run a Google Analytics (GA4) report: metrics over a date range, optionally grouped by dimensions — the workhorse for questions like "how many users last week, by country". Dates accept YYYY-MM-DD or relative forms ("today", "yesterday", "28daysAgo"). Also accepts the native GA4 request shapes directly: a single dateRanges entry in place of startDate/endDate, and metrics/dimensions as {name} objects. Unsure which dimension/metric names are valid? Call analytics_get_metadata first.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `property` | string | required | GA4 property: numeric ID like "213025502" or "properties/213025502" — NOT a "G-..." measurement ID and not "UA-...". Find yours with analytics_account_summaries. |
| `startDate` | string | optional | Start date: YYYY-MM-DD or relative ("today", "yesterday", "NdaysAgo" e.g. "28daysAgo"). Required unless dateRanges is given. |
| `endDate` | string | optional | End date: YYYY-MM-DD or relative ("today", "yesterday", "NdaysAgo"). Required unless dateRanges is given. |
| `dateRanges` | array | optional | Native GA4 shape, as an alternative to startDate/endDate: exactly one {startDate, endDate} entry (this tool runs one range per call). |
| `metrics` | array | required | Metric API names, e.g. ["activeUsers","sessions","screenPageViews"], or the native GA4 [{"name":"activeUsers"}] form. Max 10. Valid names (including custom ones) come from analytics_get_metadata. |
| `dimensions` | array | optional | Dimension API names to group by, e.g. ["date"] or ["country","deviceCategory"], or the native GA4 {"name":...} form. Max 9. Omit for a single total row. |
| `dimensionFilter` | object | optional | FilterExpression on dimensions (applies independently of metricFilter). Simple: {"filter":{"fieldName":"country","stringFilter":{"matchType":"EXACT","value":"France"}}}. AND of two: {"andGroup":{"expressions":[{"filter":{"fieldName":"country","stringFilter":{"matchType":"EXACT","value":"France"}}},{"filter":{"fieldName":"deviceCategory","stringFilter":{"matchType":"EXACT","value":"mobile"}}}]}}. matchType: EXACT \| BEGINS_WITH \| ENDS_WITH \| CONTAINS \| FULL_REGEXP (add "caseSensitive":true for case-sensitive). Also available: inListFilter, notExpression, orGroup. |
| `metricFilter` | object | optional | FilterExpression on metric values, e.g. {"filter":{"fieldName":"sessions","numericFilter":{"operation":"GREATER_THAN","value":{"int64Value":"100"}}}}. operation: EQUAL \| LESS_THAN \| LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL \| GREATER_THAN \| GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL; betweenFilter takes fromValue/toValue. |
| `orderBys` | array | optional | Sort order, e.g. [{"metric":{"metricName":"sessions"},"desc":true}] or [{"dimension":{"dimensionName":"date"}}]. Default: unordered. |
| `limit` | number | optional | Max rows to return (API default 10000). Keep small for readable output. |
| `offset` | number | optional | Zero-based row offset for pagination |
| `metricAggregations` | array | optional | Also return aggregate rows across all matching data (surfaced as totals/maximums/minimums) |
| `keepEmptyRows` | boolean | optional | Include rows whose metrics are all zero (default false) |
| `returnPropertyQuota` | boolean | optional | Include this property's remaining quota tokens in the response |
